title: MEGA CHARIZARD
description: In the depths of the Nether a creature awakens... MEGA CHARIZARD.
body:
Unleash the power of the Dragon!
The CHARIZARD Texture Pack brings Mega Charizard X into Minecraft like never before. Fully inspired by the legendary blue Mega Evolution, this pack transforms your world with intense neon blue aesthetics, aggressive claw-marked designs, and fiery dragon energy.
Features:

Epic Mega Charizard X logo and main menu overhaul
Neon Blue "CHARIZARD" title with savage claw-scratch effects
High-contrast neon blue and cyan color scheme
Fierce, glowing fire and flame textures
Custom particle effects (smoke & fire tuned for the theme)
Aggressive claw slashes and dragon-scale details across GUIs and blocks
Dark, powerful atmosphere perfect for survival or PvP

Whether you're building a dragon lair, battling in the Nether, or just want your Minecraft to look absolutely savage — this pack makes every moment feel like a Mega Evolution.
For fans of Pokémon and epic dragon vibes. 
Are you ready to feel the fury?
